title: Derivatives
tagline: Forwards and futures, swaps, option payoffs and arbitrage bounds, binomial trees, the Black–Scholes model, the Greeks and hedging, numerical methods, credit derivatives and risk measurement
summary: Derivatives — contracts whose value depends on the price of something else — are used to hedge risk, to speculate and to complete markets, and they played a central part in the financial crisis of 2008. This course prices them by no-arbitrage: forwards, futures and swaps, option payoffs and bounds, binomial trees, the Black–Scholes model and its Greeks, dynamic hedging and numerical methods, credit derivatives, and the measurement and management of financial risk.

chapters.title: Forwards and futures
chapters.summary: Forward and futures contracts, margining, cost-of-carry pricing and hedging with futures.

chapters.title: Swaps
chapters.summary: Interest-rate and currency swaps, how they are valued and what they are used for.

chapters.title: Options: payoffs and arbitrage bounds
chapters.summary: Calls and puts, payoff diagrams, spreads and combinations, put–call parity and no-arbitrage bounds.

chapters.title: The binomial model
chapters.summary: One- and multi-period binomial trees, replication, risk-neutral valuation and American options.

chapters.title: The Black–Scholes model
chapters.summary: Lognormal prices, the Black–Scholes–Merton formula as the limit of binomial trees and from the hedging argument, and implied volatility.

chapters.title: The Greeks and dynamic hedging
chapters.summary: Delta, gamma, vega, theta and rho, and hedging a portfolio of options.

chapters.title: Numerical methods and exotic options
chapters.summary: Monte Carlo simulation, finite-difference methods and path-dependent options.

chapters.title: Credit risk and credit derivatives
chapters.summary: Default probabilities and credit spreads, credit default swaps and securitisation.

chapters.title: Risk measurement and management
chapters.summary: Value at risk and expected shortfall, stress testing, and the lessons of financial crises.
